entities.name: Nasrid Kingdom
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Nasrid Kingdom, a political institution in Spain during The Reconquista (1250–1492). Grew from Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa – turning point of the Reconquista and Almohad. Led to the emergence of Fall of Granada – end of the Reconquista and Alhambra Decree expels Jews from Spain.
